newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-GUD says soft economy hits Q1 result.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-GUD says soft economy hits Q1 result.

text.p: Diversified manufacturer GUD Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday its first quarter results reflected the softness of the Australian economy.
But chairman Bruce Lithgow said the company remained confident that its 1996/97 net profit would exceed the previous year's result.
"Results for the first quarter reflect the slowdown in the economy," Lithgow told shareholders at the company's annual general meeting. The group does not release its quarterly results.
"Nevertheless, we continue to be optimistic for an overall group result for 1996/97 in excess of that for the previous year both in respect of earnings per share and net profit," he said.
GUD posted a net profit of A$10.63 million for the 12 months to June 30, 1996, up from A$10.16 million in the previous year.

Lithgow also announced that the company had formally concluded its acquisition of lawnmower and appliance group Sunbeam Victa Holdings Ltd SVH.AX. GUD offered one of its shares and 54 cents cash for every three Sunbeam shares.
At 12.45 p.m. (0145 GMT), GUD shares were three cents higher at A$3.85. -- Melbourne bureau 61-3 9286-1435
